build_nacrf_transformer_model: build a NACRFTransformerModel with encoder, decoder, and DynamicCRF layer for non-autoregressive translation
run_forward_training: run the forward pass to compute CRF loss, word insertion loss, and length prediction
run_forward_decoder_inference: run the forward decoder with Viterbi decoding through the CRF layer for inference
review_add_args_parser: review the add_args method to configure CRF low-rank approximation, beam size, and loss factor
build_nacrf_base_architecture: build the nacrf_base_architecture with default CRF low-rank, beam approximation, and normalization settings
